item.title: Shrimp boat catches fire in Bonfil Park, Mazatlán
item.description: A shrimp boat caught fire Monday afternoon at the dock near the Gabriel Leyva neighborhood of Mazatlán. According to reports from the scene, the fire and subsequent explosion occurred while welding work was being carried out on the boat when a spark fell onto the diesel tank.
